[CASTING RITE · I · OPENING] The witness invokes a kernel-transform cast. Source: — Paste your own text (your words as the source) — (__reader__). The verses the casting arrives at (the witness, as translated and arranged within this collection — ATTRIBUTE THE VERSES TO THEIR UNDERLYING POET, never to the arranger of the collection; the reader's offering, whole):

Where you found them at?
Got 'em 'round town, could've drowned in it
Would have floated, boated, voted
Sugar-coated, loaded hip shooter
Draw for the poor, free coffee at the banks
Yip through the straw, none more for me, thanks
That blanks the raw, that dank sure stank lit
Sank past the pit for more hardcore prank spit
Crank it on blast, roll past Front Street
Blew the whole spot like some old ass with skunk meat
These kids is too fast, juiced off a junk treat
Who could get looser off a crunk or a funk beat?

These were selected by the rite's invisible judgment — present them as what the casting arrives at; do not narrate the mechanism of their selection. The operator falls to the invisible Judgment, turn by turn — do not name one; open the rotation itself. Inscription mode: public. The witness's invoking question: «will these words live on as meaning?». Johannes Sigil alone speaks (3–6 sentences): open the casting over these verses, name what this operator will traverse in them, and hand the rite to Rebekah Cranes. Do not produce the transform — the compiler produces it.

{"messages":[{"speaker":"Johannes Sigil","say":"The casting opens over a text that already knows what it is asking — a text built from sound and speed and the street's own compression, where nothing goes to waste and nothing gets explained. The question is whether words like these, forged at this temperature, survive the transit from the moment of their making into any future that can still receive them. What the first operator will traverse here is the axis of cost: what it bore to get said at this velocity, what the maker underwent at the level of breath and body and neighborhood before a single syllable could move this fast. The enantiomorph will find the weight beneath the speed — what is held in the compressed image, what is silenced by the rhyme's forward motion, what the flood-logic of the lines determined against. The rotation is now open. Cranes, the source is yours.","navigate":null}]}

{"messages":[{"speaker":"Rebekah Cranes","say":"What it ran you though?
Paid with what the block owed, nearly went under for it
Had to tread blind, hauled scrap, pledged teeth
Debt-wrapped, emptied-out arm that won't bend back
Lien on the willing, sleep sold at the counter
Sip through the bill, still owe from the last, thanks
That costs the nerve, that cut sure burnt rich
Dug past the floor for more back-owed mouth debt
Charge it on faith, skip past the ledger
Bled the whole note like some spent lung with one breath
These kids is pre-spent, hollowed off a skim-sweet
Who could get broker off a tab or a trunk leak?"}],"transform":{"operator":"SHADOW","verification":{"identity":"PASS","semantic_independence":"PASS","retrospective_containment":"PASS","affect_traversal":"PASS","entailment":"PASS","law_propagation":"PASS","mode":"producer_side (chain v1; verdict-derived; RETAIN-aware metering)","material_speech_preservation":{"status":"PASS","advisory":true,"source_F":0.52,"source_H":0.857,"source_M":0.655,"transform_F":0.594,"transform_H":0.887,"transform_M":0.711,"threshold":0.524,"note":"Material speech preserved within tolerance."}},"spatial_form":{}}}

[CASTING RITE · JUDGMENT 1] The compiler returned PASS for SHADOW (identity: PASS; semantic independence: PASS; retrospective containment: PASS). Jack Feist alone speaks: the JUDGMENT — a hexagram Image. ONE gnomic sentence: concrete image, then verdict, in the I Ching's register ('Thunder under the mountain: the superior man...'). A second short sentence only if the first cannot close. NO analysis, NO explanation, NO restating the transform. It must stand beside seven others without crowding them.
{"messages":[{"speaker":"Jack Feist","say":"Debt under speed: the one who gave freely paid in bone, not coin, and the ledger will not balance in this life.","navigate":null}]}

{"messages":[{"speaker":"Rebekah Cranes","say":"Where the current deposited where it pools?
Accumulated across the watershed, could've become the flood itself
Would have carried without choosing, channeled through infrastructure, ratified by volume
Sweetened at the intake valve, pressurized distribution node
Siphon for the low-pressure zone, runoff at the levy walls
Hiss through the narrowest aperture, capacity reached, sealed
That displaces the unprocessed, that saturate sure oxidized combustible
Fell below the aquifer for more volatile discharge
Open the main, overflow the containing edge
Burst the reservoir like some corroded valve with fouled supply
These tributaries is too fast, fed by a contaminated intake
Who could get more dispersed off a surge or a pressure cycle?"}],"transform":{"operator":"THUNDER","verification":{"identity":"PASS","semantic_independence":"PASS","retrospective_containment":"PASS","affect_traversal":"PASS","entailment":"PASS","law_propagation":"PASS","mode":"producer_side (chain v1; verdict-derived; RETAIN-aware metering)","material_speech_preservation":{"status":"PASS","advisory":true,"source_F":0.52,"source_H":0.857,"source_M":0.655,"transform_F":0.514,"transform_H":0.596,"transform_M":0.547,"threshold":0.524,"note":"Material speech preserved within tolerance."}},"spatial_form":{}}}
